traits.name: Brave
traits.text: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.text: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight.
